description: Defines the DeepLinkLauncherActivity class which handles deep linking URIs to launch the PostPlaybackRatingActivity with parameters extracted from the URI query parameters.

classes.name: DeepLinkLauncherActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that parses a deep link URI to extract query parameters and starts PostPlaybackRatingActivity with these parameters.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the Activity's onCreate method to initialize the activity, parse intent data, and launch the rating activity with extracted parameters.
